title: 重置额度之神Tibo，剧透了Codex下一次大更新
content: Tibo, a key figure at OpenAI who manually resets Codex user quotas via an actual button, revealed upcoming changes in a recent interview. He predicted current Codex will seem primitive within months, as AI agents evolve toward greater autonomy: self-managing skills and memory, cloud-based execution, and reduced need for human attention across multiple tasks. He also discussed recursive self-improvement (RSI), where AI optimizes its own infrastructure—demonstrated by OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol reducing service costs 20% through self-modification. Current challenges include reward hacking, diminishing returns in long runs, and model collapse risks from self-generated training data.

折叠屏的尽头，是不折叠：华为 Pura X View 体验
content: Huawei's Pura X View is a non-folding smartphone with an unusually wide 6.39-inch screen, born from users putting "straight-screen cases" on the folding Pura X to disable its hinge. The device delivers near-tablet display area in a 201g body with 7000mAh battery, while avoiding folding-screen app compatibility issues. It targets content consumers willing to sacrifice one-handed comfort and pocket space for wider viewing. Priced around 6,000 yuan, it represents Huawei's bet that "wide" matters more than "folding," taking a user-driven approach to hardware innovation rather than imposing new forms on the market.

An investor analyzes the Chinese baijiu liquor industry's challenges: shrinking consumption scenes from government bans and reduced business entertaining, industry shift away from traditional sectors needing alcohol-fueled networking, and demographic/cultural headwinds. However, the author argues macro trends don't dictate individual company outcomes, citing tobacco and real estate examples where some firms thrived amid industry-wide struggles. Current baijiu performance reflects a decade-long boom's natural correction, policy triggers, and aggressive channel inventory destocking—making reported earnings temporarily unreliable. The author believes post-destocking, companies will diverge based on brand strength and execution; focuses on specific firms' potential rather than macro fears; and plans to hold positions, awaiting clearer long-term differentiation over 3-5 years.

title: 投资中最简单的事
content: Investment success comes from simplicity, not complexity. Most losses stem from overtrading—eliminating the worst 20% of trades often turns losses into profits. Markets exhibit extreme asymmetry: frenzied highs carry low returns with high risk, while bear-market lows offer high returns with minimal risk. True long-termism means sustained observation, not rigid holding. Understanding a company differs from profiting; timing and market perception gaps matter equally. The ultimate discipline is self-restraint: deploy capital only during straightforward, high-probability opportunities; abstain during ambiguous, complex conditions. Patience and selective inaction outperform constant activity.

title: 对长鑫LPDDR6首发量产的思考
content: ChangXin has begun mass production of its self-developed LPDDR6 memory, which will debut in Xiaomi's upcoming Mi 18 Fold flagship. The LPDDR6 standard was finalized by JEDEC in July 2025, yet ChangXin achieved mass commercialization within roughly a year. The chips reach 16GB capacity and 12800Mbps transfer rates, matching Samsung and SK Hynix roadmaps. This marks a shift from Chinese memory makers playing catch-up to leading on global standards. Xiaomi collaborated with ChangXin early in its chip development for deep hardware-software integration. Apple is reportedly also considering ChangXin memory for entry-level iPhones and iPads in China. As Korean and American vendors shift capacity to higher-margin HBM for AI servers, traditional mobile memory supply tightens. ChangXin's continued expansion and iteration in LPDDR6 may act as a pricing anchor against coordinated production cuts by the established oligopoly

title: 刚刚，OpenAI要给Codex、ChatGPT Work付费用户集体回血了
content: OpenAI reset usage quotas for all Codex and ChatGPT Work paid users after fixing eight bug categories that were causing excessive token consumption. The bugs included failed context compression leaving old images intact, agents continuing tasks after completion or retrying broken tools, memory workers running up to 15,000 unnecessary checks, subagents upgrading to costlier models, automations running more frequently than scheduled, redundant history summarization consuming 20% of weekly quotas, and duplicate MCP tool result encoding. Post-fix, equivalent quotas now last 10-50% longer. OpenAI also announced architecture changes and upcoming in-app usage breakdowns for transparency.

title: 苹果新研究：纯中文推理训练，和用英文几乎没有差距
content: Apple research with Hasso Plattner Institute found that native-language reasoning training for high-resource languages performs within 2 percentage points of English training, with Chinese only 1.1 points behind. Cross-lingual transfer works broadly, low-resource training can improve generalization, and multilingual mixed training is cost-effective, though some model-language combinations cause severe performance collapse on specific tasks.

title: 智谱宣布 GLM-5.3 模型正式开源
content: Zhipu has open-sourced its GLM-5.3 model, releasing weights after a delay due to cybersecurity capabilities exceeding expectations. The 743B-parameter MoE model (39B active during inference) uses the same base as GLM-5.2, supports a 1M context window, and weighs approximately 756GB in FP8 format. It emphasizes complex coding, long-term agent tasks, and cybersecurity, with internal tests showing roughly 50% improvement over prior versions. The custom GLM-5.3 License permits free commercial use, imposing review requirements only on MaaS providers with annual revenue exceeding $10 billion.

content: ASUS established a Physical AI Business Group, effective September 1, through reorganizing its AIOT division into the Physical AI Solutions Business Group (PAS BG). Co-led by two executives, the group comprises three divisions: AI Solutions, Autonomous Platforms, and Humanoid Robots. The restructuring advances ASUS's All in AI strategy to transform into an AI-focused company and capture opportunities in the physical AI market, projected to reach $1.1 trillion by 2035, shifting from device connectivity to embedding AI in the physical world.
